Privacy policy

Last updated: 24 November 2026

Kadar lets sports clubs film, livestream and record matches with a scoreboard in the picture. This policy explains what data the app handles and the choices you have. We collect as little as the product needs.

What we collect

  • Account data — email address and club name, when you create an account. The app also works without an account.
  • Uploaded images — club and sponsor logos you add are uploaded so they are kept with your account, and are deleted from our storage once nothing in the app uses them.
  • Subscription status — whether your account has an active PRO plan, processed by Apple/Google and RevenueCat. We never see your card details.
  • Match data — team names, players, scores, match history, leagues and cups are stored on your device. Team sheets you photograph are read on the phone itself. If you switch on remote scoring, the score and clock pass through our server between your two phones while it is on, and are not stored there.
  • Error reports — when something goes wrong (a screen fails, or the camera or stream reports an error) the app sends us a short report: the app version, the iOS version and the error text. Stream keys, access tokens and email addresses are removed before sending; stream keys are never sent. Reports are kept for 30 days and are used only to fix faults.

What we don't do

  • We don't sell or share your data with advertisers.
  • We don't record or store your video — streams go directly to the platforms you choose (YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram); local recordings stay on your phone.
  • We don't track you across other apps or websites.

Where data lives

Accounts and logos are stored with our processor Supabase in the European Union. Video is transmitted to the streaming platforms you configure, under their own terms and privacy policies.

Your rights (GDPR)

You can access, correct, export, or erase your data at any time. Delete your account and all uploaded content directly in the app (Account → Delete account & data) — deletion is immediate and permanent. For anything else, contact us at privacy@matchcast.app.

Streaming other people

You are responsible for having the right to film and broadcast your matches, including any consents your league, venue, or local law requires — especially for youth games.

Changes

If this policy changes materially, we'll note it here and in the app before the change takes effect.
